d: How did Thailand become one of the world’s most famous sex tourism destinations? This episode of Tarikh traces the history of Thailand’s sex industry, from old Siam and changing social structures to the rise of modern tourism under Field Marshal Sarit Thanarat. We explore how the Vietnam War, American soldiers, R&R, Pattaya, Bangkok nightlife, military bases and US dollars transformed Thailand’s tourism economy. The story also covers rural migration, economic inequality, HIV/AIDS, the 100% Condom Program, the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis, Amazing Thailand, human trafficking and…
